fact: Car 14 was worked on in the Fast Lane.
offence: Breach of Article 34.4 of the FIA Formula One Sporting Regulations.
reason: The Stewards heard from the team representative and reviewed video and in-car video evidence. Prior to the re-start of Q1, Car 14 drove from its Garage and its front left wheel was placed in the Fast Lane. According to the Race Director's Notes Item 11, this by definition places the car in the Fast Lane. Article 34.4 specifies that except for some specific exceptions which do not apply in this case, it is only permitted to work on a car in the inner lane. Video evidence clearly shows team members placing a jack under the rear of Car 14 and moving its location. This is deemed to be working on the car. However it appeared from video evidence that it is common practice for team members to move cars when in the Fast Lane under a red flag situation, for a variety of reasons and the regulations are currently silent on this matter. In this particular case the action of the team did not delay the session, impede another car nor gain any sporting advantage. Accordingly the Stewards determine to not apply a penalty.
rules_referenced: Article 34.4 of the FIA Formula One Sporting Regulations
stewards: in accordance with Article 15 of the FIA International Sporting Code
are based solely on the relevant regulations
title: Decision Car 14 Alleged Working In The Fast Lane
